articles.summary: Compass Pathways plc (Nasdaq: CMPS), a biotechnology company dedicated to unlocking urgently needed new treatment options in mental health care, announced today that Compass granted equity awards under the Compass Pathways plc 2026 Inducement Plan to one senior leader and ten newly hired non-executive employees. The equity awards for the senior leader were granted on September 30, 2026 and consisted of options to purchase an aggregate of 121,800 shares and restricted share units covering an aggregate of 58,000 shares. The options have an exercise price per share equal to $12.44. The equity awards to the ten newly hired non-executive employees were granted on October 1, 2026 and consisted of options to purchase an aggregate of 97,100 shares and restricted share units or, in the case of employees in the United Kingdom nominal cost options, covering an aggregate of 46,200 shares. articles.summary: First-ever Treatment-Resistant Depression (TRD) Awareness Day establishes dedicated moment to recognize and raise awareness of the condition’s profound impact on patients and their loved ones Survey data in a new report highlighting the significant burden of TRD on patients and caregivers to be released in a future communication Compass Pathways plc (Nasdaq: CMPS), a biotechnology company dedicated to unlocking urgently needed new treatment options in mental health care, today announced the first-ever TRD Awareness Day in the U.S., a day dedicated to recognizing and advocating for individuals, caregivers and communities impacted by TRD. The campaign is being amplified by leading mental health organizations, including National Alliance on Mental Illness (NAMI), Mental Health America (MHA) and the Depression and Bipolar Support Alliance (DBSA). articles.summary: Compass Pathways plc (Nasdaq: CMPS), a biotechnology company dedicated to unlocking urgently needed new treatment options in mental health care, today celebrated the opening of its new U.S. office in Jersey City, New Jersey, with a ribbon-cutting ceremony attended by company leaders, employees and local officials. The new 6,327-square-foot office will serve as a hub for Compass employees across the tri-state area. The space will bring together teams across functions as Compass advances U.S. commercial readiness activities for COMP360, its investigational synthetic psilocybin treatment program for treatment-resistant depression, in anticipation of a potential U.S. launch in the first half of 2027, subject to FDA approval. Compass selected Jersey City because of its proximity to one of the country's most established life sciences and healthcare ecosystems, access to a strong local talent pool and its growing role as a destination for biotechnology innovation.
